# shipwithmuse.live

shipwithmuse.live is a curated catalog of everything people are shipping with Meta's Muse, indexed by use case: 1,085 real examples and counting. Each entry links to its public source: an X post, a Reddit thread, a GitHub repo, a video, a site, a skill, a resource or a guide.

The catalog is hand-sorted into 10 shelves: Errands and personal agent, Local and open models, Coding and dev tools, Benchmarks and research, Connectors and MCP, Games and 3D, Business and commerce, Content and creative, Agents and automation, Apps and websites. Every accepted entry gets a stable four-digit catalog number, and the editor's picks (starred) mark things you can concretely check, like a repo that runs or a verifiable number. Upvotes are a reader signal only. Alongside the catalog there are guides: beginner tutorials, connector guides and community roundups.

Filing a build is free: send the link to something you built with Muse and posted about publicly. Good demos with video or screenshots go to the top of the queue, a human reviews every submission, and once approved your build is featured at the top of the homepage with your name and profile. The site is independent: Meta does not run, review or endorse it.

Honest caveats: this is a showcase, not a store. There are no sellers, no prices and no install flow: it is discovery only. An entry exists only if it points to a public source, and numbers like cost, run time or savings are repeated as the author's claim, not verified by the site....
